Colour: in an art line a space is class none, a character in accent_chars is class accent and any other character is class base; in the subtitle a space is class none and any other character is class subtitle_color. A class whose colour is null is class none (the terminal's own text colour). An SGR code is emitted only when the class changes: none emits ESC[0m and a hex colour emits ESC[38;2;R;G;Bm. A line that ends in a coloured class gets ESC[0m before its newline. golden_sha256 holds the sha256 of the two UTF-8 outputs. sha256 is the sha256 of every other field, as json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).
